answer: Unrepeatable Challenge-Response Ledger. Each identity must solve a fresh, verifier-signed puzzle whose result is a hash chained to that identity's prior answer, so a solution cannot be copied to a second identity or replayed. An attacker cannot forge a valid chain without recomputing every link, and parallelism hits its zenith at the per-identity recomputation wall. A haven of cheap precomputed answers never forms, since each new link invalidates the last. Cost: full sequential work per identity, no sharing.
